profile.name: Van Loc
profile.headline: A passionate Frontend Developer from Viet Nam
summary: With more than 4 years of experience as a Front-End Developer, I specialize in building dynamic, scalable web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I am proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frontend libraries such as Redux.

I have worked on large-scale projects in airline payment, travel/tour platforms, CRM systems, e-commerce solutions, and outsourcing products. My experience includes building booking flows, payment systems, customer portals, admin dashboards, product catalogs, checkout processes, and internal management tools while ensuring performance, accessibility, and scalability.

I have strong experience collaborating with backend teams using .NET APIs, SDKs, and cloud services, helping deliver seamless frontend-backend integration. I have also worked with Azure-related systems for task management, deployment pipelines, and infrastructure support.

Beyond coding, I focus on writing clean, maintainable code, improving UI/UX, optimizing performance, and collaborating effectively with cross-functional and global teams. I stay up to date with modern technologies and always aim to deliver reliable, high-quality products.

responsibilities: Built and maintained web platforms in the airline payment and travel/tour domain, including booking systems, payment gateways, customer portals, and internal operation tools.
Managed project tasks, sprint planning, and delivery workflows with Azure DevOps.
Developed scalable frontend architecture following Atomic Design principles to improve code reusability, maintainability, and long-term scalability.
Built responsive interfaces for both customer-facing and admin systems based on design specifications, covering airline booking, payment management, and tour operations.
Worked with Azure cloud services and related infrastructure (CI/CD, hosting, storage, monitoring) to support deployment, release management, and system reliability.
Established engineering workflows with Husky, Commitlint, GitHub Actions, code review, and automated testing to improve development quality.
Configured Storybook for UI documentation and wrote technical documentation to support team collaboration and onboarding.
Improved application performance, SEO, and overall user experience through continuous optimization, refactoring, and code maintenance.
